milestones.description: Bizo Secures $10 Million Series B Funding
milestones.source_text:
At MediaPost's OMMA Global conference this week, Bizo (http://www.bizo.com), the world's first targeted B2B advertising network, will announce that it has completed its private beta and has now opened registration to any qualifying B2B marketer, publisher or data provider. Bizo has created the first advertising network designed specifically to help the B2B marketer reach targeted business audiences online.

Bizo has been operating in a private beta since May, building its technology platform and working with multiple agencies, advertisers and publishers, including 90octane, AvenueA-Razorfish, Black Bag, CareerBuilder, Digital Element, InterCLICK, Plaxo, Revenue Science, Right Media, Tiburon Media, Unreal Marketing, WhitePages, Worldata, Yahoo!, ZoomInfo and others. Earlier this year, Bizo spun out of and was wholly funded by ZoomInfo (http://www.zoominfo.com). As a result, existing ZoomInfo investors, including Venrock, Flagship, Ascent, and Vulcan, are significant shareholders in the new company.

"As a B2B marketer myself, I know firsthand that there are limited options for effective B2B advertising online today," said Russell Glass, Bizo's founder and CEO. "This is exciting because the B2B marketer is now able to reach precise business audiences across the web - for many, Bizo makes online marketing viable for the first time."

Bizo's technology aggregates anonymous bizographic data from many different sources and optimizes it to deliver a unique understanding of the bizographics of its audience: elements such as industry, functional area, seniority, education and location, etc. With this understanding, Bizo delivers remarkable targeting centered on these attributes and behaviors.

"This is a logical extension of the many uses of high quality business data," said Jonathan Stern, founder of both ZoomInfo and Bizo. "Bizo delivers highly relevant advertising for the B2B marketer and helps publishers monetize their sites more effectively."

"The business targeting that Bizo's network provides has generated about a 100% increase in the value of the inventory we're using to target ads," said Jay Schwedelson, the Corporate Vice President of Worldata, a list and interactive marketing company that participated in the beta. "Our campaigns are twice as effective as they were before using Bizo."

Bizo also announced the availability of Bizo Analyze (http://www.bizo.com/home/analyze-overview), its free analytics tool. Analyze allows any site owner to measure and track the bizographics of the visitor traffic to their site and shows a breakdown of the industry, company size, functional area, seniority and even the education level of that traffic.

"Marketers spend over 50% of their budget on their Website, yet often only have a cursory understanding of who is visiting their site," said Glass. "Analyze tells marketers who's there to help them better convert that traffic to customers."

Bizo's B2B advertising network and Analyze are available now and the company is currently accepting applications for publisher, data provider and advertiser relationships at www.bizo.com/contact. Bizo will be presenting its entire line of services at MediaPost's OMMA Global in NYC September 18th and 19th at booth #405.

About Bizo

Bizo, Inc. is the world's first targeted B2B advertising network, and currently reaches over 20 million targeted business people across thousands of sites on the web. Bizo has created a new approach to online B2B marketing with precise ad targeting that's based on a prospect's bizographics - industry, functional area, seniority, size of company, education, gender, location and more. This unique understanding of a person's bizographics allows Bizo to anonymously deliver powerful ad targeting based on these attributes and behaviors.

-    For a B2B marketer, Bizo delivers the ability to target specific business audiences on publisher sites across the web to easily and affordably capture highly qualified leads.

-    For a publisher, Bizo delivers remarkable monetization of its audience both on and off its site.

-    For business audiences, Bizo decreases the volume of irrelevant and annoying advertising across the web. Bizo only utilizes anonymous information, ensuring complete privacy.

Bizo is privately held and based in San Francisco, CA.

name: Asankya
overview:
Asankya provides solutions to companies in the rapidly growing market of cloud-based applications and streaming services. The ubiquity of reliable, always-on Internet connections has made it possible for companies to move applications, data, and media from disk-based distribution to cloud-based services. Analyst firm William Blair and Co. predicts the cloud services market to reach $34 billion per year by 2012, but the growth of cloud applications and media is currently limited by the quality of experience of transferring data into and out of the cloud.

Previous solution attempts do not adequately address the problems cloud service providers are facing. Content Delivery Networks focus only on downloading content and are highly application specific. WAN Optimization devices, built for point-to-point communication, require high capital expenditure and were not designed for the variability of the Internet and mobile networks. Peer-to-Peer networks are inherently insecure, underperforming, and cannot accommodate real-time interactive content.

Asankya’s solution optimizes transport speed bi-directionally in a way that supports encrypted communications and even streaming services for a significantly enhanced experience. Asankya has developed patent-pending technology that provides intelligent network characterization and scheduling capabilities to manage data flows. Asankya’s Hypermesh service enables each packet of a data stream to be sent along a different network path, dynamically avoiding bottlenecks and congestion points that currently limit speed and quality, while still maintaining packet order. As more applications, data, and media services move to the cloud, Asankya’s innovative capabilities enhance the performance of cloud-based services for a fast, secure, and globally consistent experience.

overview:
Yandex is an internet technologies company that operates in Russia, CIS and Turkey. It is the largest Russian and one of the world’s largest internet search engine. Yandex is an acronym for the phrase Yet Another Indexer.

As of June 2013, Yandex had 61.6% of the Russian search market (source: LiveInternet.ru).

Yandex’s mission is to give the answer to the user anytime and anywhere. Company provides its services for desktop and mobile users and develops embedded solutions as well.

The company specializes on highly-targeted sophisticated web search and information retrieval services based on world-class technologies like a proprietary machine-learning method MatrixNet.

Yandex provides localized services for its users, as well as enables them to search for websites in other languages.

In addition to web search the company offers dozens of free online services, granting access to extensive local, national and international information. The services include maps; traffic jams information; photo and video hosting; cloud storage; news service; spam-free email and many others.

In 2012, Yandex’s revenue totaled to $947.1 million while net income jumped to $288.7 million. Contextual ads accounted for 87% of the company’s revenues as of Q4 2012.

overview:
Pingdom is a website and performance monitoring company dedicated to making the web faster and more reliable. With Pingdom’s monitoring service, users will be the first to know of any issues with their website, DNS, email server, or any other infrastructure they choose to monitor.

With Pingdom’s service, customers are alerted of any issues so that they can focus on their daily business. The platform allows customers to easily and quickly set up monitoring without all the technical work normally involved. All that is needed is a URL, Pingdom will take care of the rest.

Pingdom offers a complete monitoring package including website monitoring, transaction monitoring to ensure all interactions on a website is working, and real user monitoring for website performance. There is also a host of free tools for website owners to test their website’s speed, DNS settings, and perform Ping or a Traceroute.

name: Sonico
overview:
Founded in July 2007, Sonico is the social network in Latin America that organizes people’s lives online. This social media platform has more than 75 million registered users, and allows individuals, organizations and brands to interact in an easy, useful and entertaining way without losing control over their privacy. Sonico is among the top 50 sites across Spanish and Portuguese speaking markets. Sonico is a complete social networking ecosystem that allows members to organize their lives via three distinct profiles: Private, Public and Professional.

Easy to use Easy navigation with a sleek design.

Customization Unique profile designs.

Real users - Real connections Real first and last names with real user’s photo.

Content moderation Content moderation to make sure that the information posted on the network is accurate and appropriate.

Security and Privacy Private profiles closed to general Internet users. The level of exposure of the information can be customized.

Sonico works as a key complement to the integral solution that Fnbox companies provide to its users by turning their lives more productive and enjoyable, while helping them to solve everyday problems. Since its beginnings the company is committed to provide the most reliable communications services, and achieving total customer satisfaction.

name: eBureau
overview:
eBureau helps consumer-facing businesses find their next customer—more cost effectively—through predictive analytics.

With its next-generation predictive analytics platform, eBureau delivers powerful insights to online marketers, financial services companies and agencies. The company’s suite of lead quality scoring, audience targeting, contact center optimization, and risk management solutions provide outstanding results for clients seeking to optimize performance throughout their customer life cycle.

eBureau has reinvented how custom statistical scores are developed and deployed. Its patented system architecture combines proprietary database management software and vast amounts of predictive content in order to seamlessly integrate hundreds of billions of records across thousands of databases, covering nearly all U.S. adults and households. Its embedded statistical modeling technology allows eBureau to develop eScores for its clients in a single day, rather than over several weeks or months.

milestones.description: CoverItLive Now Lets You Add Qik To Your Live Blogs
milestones.source_text:
My favorite liveblogging tool, CoverItLive (see Ultimate liveblogging tool: CoverItLive), is set to add support for live video Tuesday. But rather than launch its own video-streaming service, the system now lets authors insert video embeds from uStream, Qik, or Mogulus into a live blog.

This approach gives CoverItLive users flexibility, but at the cost of simplicity of use. The cool thing is that bloggers have a choice of video services. If you are live-blogging a speech, for example, and you have a good view of the stage, you can pop a Webcam onto your laptop and stream it to your viewers via uStream. If you're live-blogging a news event from a desk indoors but the news is happening outside, you can embed someone else's Qik camera phone video instead. Regardless, as soon as you paste in the video embed code from your streaming service, a little window will in your viewers' CoverItLive content windows. They can pop out and expand the video if they wish, or close it.

CoverItLive now lets authors embed live video streams.
(Credit: CoverItLive)

The downside is that bloggers will need be logged in to both CoverItLive and their video service to post their own videos into their live blog. That's not a critical flaw, but when you're live-blogging an event and trying to focus on creating great content, dealing with two services at once is a lot to handle.

CoverItLive CEO Keith McSpurren admits that the current level of video integration in the product is a bit of an experiment, done in part because noisy tech bloggers like me were clamoring for it, and in part because adding video via embeds was quite simple. He may add deeper integration in the future, such as integrated sign-ons done in partnership with the streaming companies, if the current experiment is a success.

McSpurren says that only about 20 percent of CoverItLive's use is for covering conferences, where the uStream integration will likely be employed. He told me that he's seeing the most use come from sports and politics coverage, where audiences are larger and where rebroadcasting video is tightly restricted. He's also seen big spikes in usage during disasters, where local news operations have kept live blogs open for hours at a time, to keep readers up to date on road closures, shelter locations, weather conditions, and the like. "Natural disasters have been a strange boon for the business," McSpurren told me.

It's public service live blogging like this where I see the Qik video integration having great human value. If a reporter is live-blogging an event from a newsroom and a reader is on the front lines--driving past firetrucks on the way to a shelter, for example--the writer could easily paste in the reader's Qik embed link to show readers what's happening on the ground. Clearly, this would require that people in highly stressful situations take the time and energy to fire up a cell phone video stream, so I wouldn't expect to see a wildfire live blog overwhelmed with available video streams. But a smart firefighter or police officer might want to provide a livestream to reporters to illustrate the conditions they are facing. See also: NowPublic (Reuters 2.0?), which has a lot of conceptual overlap with this concept.

Other liveblog tools worth looking at include Scribblelive and Google Docs.
milestones.source_description: CoverItLive gets live video support, of a sort

milestones.description: CoveritLive now in 8 languages, Live Edit, Search Engine Optimizer
milestones.source_text:
8 LANGUAGES
In an effort to better meet the needs of our international users (30% of readership of CoveritLive live blogs are from outside of North America) we are happy to announce that users can now choose one of eight languages for their Viewer Window:

English, German, French, Japanese, Chinese, Portuguese, Spanish and Italian

Instead of trying to figure out what things like, "Vote Now" or "Your comment has been sent" mean, millions of readers will now be able to enjoy live blogs entirely in their own language.

To use this new feature, go to 'My Viewer Window' in your account and select a new default language for your template.

LIVE EDIT
Although you could always edit your live blog once it was complete, the new LIVE EDIT feature allows you to fix any errors or delete any unwanted entries while your live blog is still LIVE.  This was a feature our many users at newspapers were asking for (or maybe their editors were asking for it).

To use this new feature while LIVE, go to 'Tools' and select the LIVE EDIT tab.  Hover over the entry you wish to edit, make your changes and save. Your Viewer Window is instantly updated with no effort from your readers.

SEO (Search Engine Optimization) Help
A potential drawback that concerns users of hosted software is that search engines will not credit their site for content in a hosted application (like CoveritLive).  If this is a concern of yours, there are two important points to keep in mind:

1. A properly tagged and titled live blog on your site or blog will drive the vast majority of search results to the right page.  For example, if you Googled "USA versus Greece" yesterday, the blog 'Ball Don't Lie' from Yahoo would have been on the first page of results...they were using CoveritLive.

2. All CoveritLive live blogs can be downloaded and copied directly onto your site/blog once complete.  Go to 'Completed Live Blogs' and click 'Save Content Locally'.  We have formatted the content nicely so it still looks like our Instant Replay.  Simply paste that content and it will get picked up as any other content on your site.

There are other, more sophisticated solutions we are looking into to make this process more simple but if you keep the two points above in mind, SEO should not be a concern when using CoveritLive.

Thanks again for the continued support.
Keith McSpurren

tag_list: local, localsearch, restaurants, restaurant-marketing, online-ordering, ecommerce
overview:
Dotmenu was born over a decade ago when company founder Michael Saunders was a junior at the University of Pennsylvania. While studying for finals, Saunders decided to order himself a tuna hoagie. After encountering two busy signals and one accidental disconnection, his delivery order was placed. When the hoagie finally arrived, Michael was saddened by the discovery of condiments he most certainly had not requested.

A lesser man might have just swallowed his frustration, but Michael Saunders decided to act, if only to keep future generations of tuna hoagie craving college kids from suffering the same fate. Michael set himself to the task of building an online restaurant network that would make busy signals, disconnections, and grievously misheard toppings requests a thing of the distant past. After many years, Michael’s dream became a reality.

For over a decade now, Dotmenu has been making it easier to stuff food into people’s faces. Thanks to the massive growth of our flagship websites Allmenus and Campusfood, Dotmenu has expanded its waistline to become the largest online food delivery network in the world with over 1.7 million registered users, nearly half of whom are college graduates.

Having started out on just 18 campuses in 2000, Campusfood is now the number one late-night pizza and wings solution on 400 college campuses. Allmenus boasts over 250,000 menus, connecting famished Americans with their favorite restaurants in nearly every major city. Our sites have been featured in The Wall Street Journal, The New York Times, Businessweek, and too many other publications to name.

Headquartered in the Flatiron District of New York City, Dotmenu is a privately owned company composed of talented, innovative, and yes, hungry individuals. The team collaborates in a creative, fast-paced environment, dedicated to forging new partnerships, and expanding our network even further.

name: Open Television Network
overview:
The Open Television Network provides a web service called klickTab that enables audio and video content owners to sell their content within an RSS feed inside standard ‘podcast’ aggregators. The klickTab system is an unmediated marketplace open to any content owner who wants to sell in a non-discriminatory manner. Each merchant creates their own account and hosts their own content. They enter metadata on content items within the klickTab system and can sell individual items in an RSS feed (that sends the media item to their aggregator of choice) or they can create channel feeds analogous to standard podcasts. Merchants get embed codes for the single item sale, or for the channel feeds they create. We provide a template for easily creating a store within the merchant’s site in addition to the embed code for item and feeds.

The OpenTVNetwork.com site is used to showcase content available in the system. Content can be purchased there, and feeds subscribed to. Open Television Network takes 15% of the price the merchant sets for their content. Affiliates (when available) will get 15% from the merchant’s share, unless the merchant opts out of affiliate sales.

name: Agent Shield Technologies
overview:
Agent Shield is a FREE, patent pending, web 2.0 technology that makes it easy and safe for REALTORS to sell new construction properties.

Quick Stats:

  • REALTORS are the #1 sales force for real estate.
  • REALTORS, depending on geographical location, account for 51 to over 90% of new construction sales.
  • Less than 1% of REALTORS actively promote, market and sell new construction properties.

The majority of REALTORS do not benefit from selling new construction because of the following barriers:

  1. Lack of access: New construction properties/developments are typically not in the MLS.
  2. New Construction was difficult to market: REALTORS did not have access to promotional material that was easy to distribute.
  3. High risk of being cut out of the transaction: There were no mechanism to provide a level of compensation protection.

Solution: Agent Shield provides the whole REALTOR community with the opportunity and benefits of selling new construction properties.

Easy access to new construction: We do all the work of signing up new developments into the Agent Shield Network. REALTORS are provided with FREE widgets with new construction properties to add to their current website which easily provide access for their clients and prospects.

Easy to market new construction: With 84% of buyers researching real estate online, Agent Shield allows the REALTOR’s prospects to continue performing their own research. Powered by Agent Shield’s technology, the REALTOR’s prospects are directed (through the widget on their website or via emails) to the actual new development’s website to research and learn more about the development.

Safe to market new construction: The referring REALTOR retains full control of their prospect/lead. When the prospect arrives at the new development’s website, Agent Shield’s technology automatically changes all of the contact information to the referring REALTOR’s. All emails sent from the contact forms go to the referring REALTOR. The developer does not receive the lead’s information.

Opens up 2nd home market to REALTORS: Most areas are feeders markets for other areas. For example, New York is the top feeder market for SW Florida. Agent Shield provides REALTORS with access to new developments around the world thus opening the opportunity for the REALTOR to continue servicing their clients who are looking to purchase a second home elsewhere. Servicing the second home buyer is easy. Agent Shield provides the new development’s website as a research tool for the buyer.

Agent Shield will revolutionize the way new construction properties are marketed by REALTORS on the internet. Every REALTOR can now easily expand their inventory offerings and benefit from selling new construction. Agent Shield is FREE for REALTORS. More information and a 80 second video of how Agent Shield works can be found at www.AgentShield.com.

name: FiveSeven Studios
overview:
FiveSeven Studios is a small branding and marketing agency founded by Jason VanLue, dedicated to building brands through crafting memorable brand experiences. At FiveSeven we help small to medium sized organizations practically apply niche-specific brand strategy to create opportunities for growth in the marketplace.

As a small, close-knit branding and marketing agency, we are dedicated to helping small and medium sized organizations distill high-level brand practices into practical, relevant, and effective branding solutions that actually make a difference. Effective brand design and development is not just for large organizations, and through our proven Brand-Aid process, we apply the best practices of global brand leaders to a localized niche model. Whether you are a small business, church, non-profit, or professional organization, we’ll help position your brand for success and growth.

Our clients are our highest priority. We believe that effective marketing and branding solutions are those that are functionally applied to the individual client — so rest assured that we won’t suggest anything that you don’t need, and will seek to provide the best quality service for what you do need. We believe a successful relationship is built on communication and connection. This is achieved through clear, upfront, and meaningful dialogue from the very beginning, in addition to a foundational understanding of your goals, vision, and plan for growth. We want to get to know you intimately, because from this, we can then offer creative solutions that are optimal for your individual situation.

Since 2004 FiveSeven has maintained a reputation for unparalleled service, uncompromising quality, strong client relationships, and expert knowledge. As a small branding and marketing agency, we understand the challenges of building a business or organization in today’s world. We would love the opportunity to show you why numerous clients from the Fortune 100 to local start-ups trust their creative strategy to us. FiveSeven Studios is privately held and located in Maitland, a suburb of Orlando in beautiful Central Florida.

FiveSeven has had the opportunity to work with senior executives and top creatives at some of the world’s most recognized companies including NBC-Universal, Fox News, and Yum! Brands. name: VMware
overview:
VMware, Inc. provides virtualization solutions. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Palo Alto, California.

Its virtualization platform products include Player that enables individuals to run virtual machines on their desktops; Fusion, a desktop virtualization product for users of Intel-based Apple Macintosh computers; Workstation for software developers and enterprise IT professionals; Server, which enables virtual partitioning of a server; ESX Server, an enterprise-class virtualization platform that runs directly on the hardware; Virtual SMP that enables a virtual machine to use four physical processors simultaneously; and VMFS, which allows multiple ESX Servers to share block-based storage.

The company also offers VirtualCenter that provides a central point of control to manage a virtualized IT environment; VMotion, which allows users to move virtual machines; DRS that creates resource pools from physical servers; HA_, which provides automated recovery from hardware failure; _Consolidated Backup that enables LAN-free automated backup of virtual machines; Storage VMotion, which allows live migration of virtual machine disks; Update Manager that automates patch and update management; Capacity Planner, which enables VMware service providers to perform capacity assessments onsite; Converter to convert local and remote physical machines into virtual machines; Lab Manager to automate the setup, capture, storage, and sharing of multi-machine software configurations; ACE that allows desktop administrators to protect company resources against the risks presented by unmanaged desktops; Virtual Desktop Infrastructure to host individual desktops inside virtual machines running on centralized servers; Virtual Desktop Manager, a desktop management server that connects users to virtual desktops in the data center; and VMware Lifecycle Manager that provides control over the virtual environment.

overview:

Located at Stanford University July 6 - 17, 2010 and Santa Clara University August 2 - 13, 2010, executives from top companies like Apple, Google, and Cisco coach the students in the basics of marketing, sales, product design and financial management.

The founders of “Hot” Silicon Valley start-ups like Hara, Better World Books, Serious Materials, Valence Energy, Hope Labs, and Fitness One challenge business teams to design solutions to real world problems. Each team writes a business plan they must defend to a panel of real investors. The winning team is invited to appear at a national event. Two years ago the winner went live on stage at the World Innovation Forum in New York City where they were interviewed by Cisco CTO, Padma Warrior.

overview:

NeuroVigil’s patent-pending and proprietary technology provides for extremely rapid, automated, and accurate reading and interpretation of electroencephalogram data, which is a window to the functioning of the brain.

The Company’s technology not only automates current manual tasks, but also more than quadruples the amount of useful information obtained from current EEG data, which may lead in the future to neural signatures, or correlates of important disease states, that will be useful in early detection and diagnosis of important medical conditions.

NeuroVigil is the winner of the fourth annual DFJ Venture Challenge, a business plan competition sponsored by Draper Fisher Jurvetson (DFJ), DFJ Frontier, and Zone Ventures, that awards $250,000 in seed funding to the winner.

overview:
Niwango, Inc. is operating Nico Nico Douga, Japan’s second largest online video portal after Youtube. The site is only available in Japanese.

The user-generated site was established in January 2007 and became one of the fastest-growing web services in the Japanese history. As of May 2008, Nico Nico Douga has over 7 million members (regular and mobile version combined) and gets around 2 billions page views a month. Users uploaded a total of 1.1 million videos.

Nico Nico Douga is mostly frequented by young Japanese males. In contrast to Youtube, most of the content is focused on Japanese pop culture (anime, video-game, footage, Japanese pop music videos etc.).

The site offers a unique comment function enabling users to communicate via texts placed directly on top of the videos. Japanese users spend twice as much time on Nico Nico Douga as they do on Youtube. In total, over 1.2 billion comments were added to Nico Nico Douga until May 2008.

overview:

Guides can be purchased in two formats - full color printed guides are available for $24.95 or downloadable guides in PDF format can be had for $9.95. Offbeat Guides was founded by Dave Sifry, who previously founded Technorati.

overview:
Cubic Lime is a Designer Web Application company… and that might make you start wondering… what exactly is a ‘Designer Web Application company’? Well, we like the sound of it, just like Starbucks coffee ala designer coffee, nicely blended and always tasting good.

So to help you… and us… to understand the meaning of Designer Web Application, we have come out with our own definition of a Designer Web Application:-

Designer Web Application [de-sig-ner web ap-pli-ca-tion]

  • Well-designed web applications that make people happy using them;

  • With great-looking interface (no grey color background with bevel grey color buttons!) for user friendly experience which make people happy using them;

  • Work well and does not take forever to load and, of course, make people happy using them.

OK, so that’s our definition of Designer Web Application and if you think your company is one of them, feel free to use the term; it’s not copyrighted! But do tell us if you decide to use it so we know we aren’t the only crazy ones out here!

name: onTV Europe
overview:

The XML-based metadata feeds cover US networks (ABC, CBS, Fox, NBC, SciFi, The CW, The N, USA Network), UK channels (BBC iPlayer, ITV, 4oD and Five) as well as TV shows available online through aggregators, such as iTunes and iTunes GB, AOL video, Amazon Unbox and BitTorrent. Extended data set includes information enabling geo-filtering of content access by users.

Coverage of the onTV feed is being extended to include movies available online through Amazon Unbox and iTunes - to be followed by other major online movie suppliers. It is its objective to be the main source for metadata on professionally produced quality content online, as it becomes available. Coverage of other geographical markets and formats is planned for the months ahead.

Besides metadata services, onTV’s own TV metadata publishing framework can be used in other analytical and publishing projects.

name: Monkiri
overview:
Monkiri lets you grab any part of the web page and instantly publish it either on your Monikri blog or send it to your Blogger or Wordpress blog.

Literally Monkiri means the Japanese art of paper cutting. Newspaper clippings are always a means amongst any knowledge enthusiasts to store a piece of information. In the web world Monkiri meets the same need. Monkiri lets one read and write blogs about any item published on a website.

With the help of Monkiri button a user can snap required portion of the item on the web page and blog it. The user can then give a comprehensive review of the same and add on his comments. The “View Entries” feature from Monkiri menu enables other interested users to visit the blogged item and comment on the same. In this way everyone visiting that page can review the comments giving one a potentially large audience. Over a period of time users can build up an online journal of articles of interest. In other words, Monkiri makes blogging and sharing a simple affair.

One of the main features of Web 2.0 is the democratization of the web where web users are no longer content to be passive observers of information that has been fed to them — they want to be active participants. Monkiri has been developed to take this advantage of Web 2.0.

Online game and virtual world for kids launches paid subscriptions for enhanced features and new content.
 San Francisco, Calif. â€” February 5, 2009 â€” Dizzywood (www.dizzywood.com), an online game and virtual world for children ages 8-12, announced today that it has surpassed the milestone of one million registered players. Dizzywood launched a beta version of the site in November 2007 and since then, has experienced rapid growth with thousands of new users joining daily. The memberships are available in two tiers; Gold Explorer memberships are priced at $9.95 per month and Silver Explorer memberships cost $6.95 per month. â€œDizzywood provides a place where kids can play in a fun, safe, and imaginative environment. We are thrilled that over one million players have already begun exploring everything that Dizzywood has to offer,â€ said Scott Arpajian, co-founder and CEO of Dizzywood, â€œThrough the rapid adoption of the game, our players are telling us that they are excited about the collaborative and cooperative game-play that sets Dizzywood apart.â€
About Dizzywood
Dizzywood's mission is to inspire young people to use their imagination and have fun, while learning real-life values and skills. Dizzywood's creative, story-driven world offers children a safe virtual environment where they can explore worlds unlike any other, engage in challenging activities and cooperate with others, while developing important cognitive skills. Kids are appropriately challenged with games and activities that earn unique super powers and other creative rewards. overview:
StreamFocus is an on-demand integrated project, workflow and action (task) management system that keeps teams focused on the next action that will have the biggest impact on customer value.

StreamFocus offers easy and dynamic linking of project workflows to respond to the situation at hand. These critical path links prevent costly rework by showing only top priority critical actions for all project participants.

All participants are integrated into the project structure, from internal staff to vendors and customers. The customer owns the project and the collaborators own their workflows within the overall project structure - each constraining the others as the project’s overall critical path demands.

Store emails, phone calls, meeting notes and documents, organized contextually within the workflow, naturally as the work is done. File storage is reliable, secure, online and backed up in multiple secured locations hosted by Amazon’s S3 Simple Storage Service. Our workflow templates allow capturing of and reusing workflow knowledge and finding information using those templates.

All active operations within Streamfocus are contextually timed. For example, if you add a document such as a phone call to an action, the system automatically starts a session for you linked to that action as you begin the call.

overview:

TEC developed a Web-based decision support system, which is coupled with its own analyst-vetted research on thousands of enterprise software features and vendor market data.

TEC’s online research products and services address many industries through articles, dynamic functionality reports, RFP templates, competitive comparisons, custom research reports (executive briefs, vendor viability analyses, pricing/peer profiling estimates, etc.), blogs, and podcasts.

name: Betaface
tag_list: visual-search, video-indexing, facial-recognition, video-search, images-search, face-recognition, face-detection, face-tracking
overview:
Betaface offers facial recognition solutions and computer vision powered rich media indexing service.

Its computer vision and machine learning technology enables new content discovery method, unrelated to current model of relying on human interaction to tag, describe, and classify images as more photos, videos, and other forms of rich media find their way online.

Betaface provides new automatic metadata extraction and search possibilities based on proprietary, unique algorithms that overperform other methods. Advanced face recognition, employed independently or in combination with speech, text and object recognition provides unbeatable accuracy, speed and scale of search results for images and video data.

In addition to core recognition and analysis processes we employ other face-related measurements like age and gender detection, detection of hairstyle, hair color and skin color, facial hair detection, glasses detection, shape analysis of facial features to automatically extract additional biometric metadata.

name: Nexnet
tag_list: advertising, interactive-advertising, interactive-programming, interactive-services, iptv, marketing, mobile, ocap, voting-polling
overview:
The Pearl by Nexnet is a method that allows viewers to respond to an on-screen cue (a “Pearl” icon appears) with their remote control, resulting in an instantaneous e-mail to the individuals personal e-mail in-box regarding the topic or product appearing on the screen at that time. The topic can be informational or promotional and also works with recorded content. This e-mail generated from the click of the remote guides the viewer effortlessly to the exact information or product requested. Visits to these websites can be tracked — a significant interest to advertisers. The links can be sent to any number of e-mail addresses in the household.

Nexnet provides all e-mail creation, customization and reporting through its web interface with the Nexnet server database for PEARL. Advertisers, Content Providers and Operators can facilitate all their PEARL needs through an on-line system that can be accessed from anywhere around the world giving maximum flexibility to campaign creation and management.

Nexnet provides a deeper level of detail about the subscriber base. Data is accumulated based on the viewer instead of the household. This helps the operator understand who watches TV in each household, which TV/STB they are using and what the viewer is interested in watching. This depth of granularity down to the specific viewer is not available through any other service.

name: Afrizi
overview:
Afrizi is a social networking site with a vision to becoming the most value-adding and biggest income source to users in Africa. Afrizi attempts to connect Africans and friends of Africans within Africa and anywhere else in the world.

Founded by two Nigerians, the Alpha Version was launched on the 4th of June, 2008. Afrizi, initially launched last year as a city business guide before being totally re-oriented and re-launched as a social networking site but only keeping the name for its uniqueness in terms of affinity with the vision for which it is now set up. Afrizi provides basic services such as photo sharing, blogs, discussions etc

Unlike the usual social networking services in the Africa, Afrizi adds other features. “Ad Place” a feature which allows users to post free classified ads. “Ad share” also offers a unique service whereby users can generate income by promoting their own pages and attracting advertisers to place ads using the unique “URL” which is automatically allocated when users sign up. A user page ranking will automatically be generated to rate pages based on user activity through “Page Worth” — a page ranking system that uses a proprietary algorithm. This is intended to determine user page worthiness and consequently, the value for which advertisers will be paying. They hope this will add value to users and become a substantial income stream in the future while also ensuring profitable returns on advertisers’ investment.

name: Yakabod
overview:
Yakabod was founded in 2001 by a couple of technologists tired of spending billable hours on stuff that didn’t matter. They decided to shake up the atrophied world of enterprise software with a knowledge sharing system that was straightforward to use, quick to deploy, and secure enough to meet the most rigorous standards.

About the product: The Yakabox, which is a knowledge-sharing system integrates four applications (collaboration, content management, search, and social networking) on one appliance. It’s super easy to use, features PL3 security certification, and is great for employee mobility.

What’s especially cool about Yakabox is that the navigation so straightforward that users are productive with no training. Plus, it’s extensible from dozens of users to tens of thousands with no infrastructure disruption.

Co-founders Scott Ryser and Scott Williamson spent two years working on the platform, which debuted in 2003 as the Yakabox. The United States Department of Defense bought the first one. Today, people all over the world log onto a Yakabox each morning to accomplish real work—stuff that matters—instead of hunting for, waiting for, and re-creating the information they need to do their jobs.

Here at Yakabod we’re committed to lives that matter. It’s satisfying to go home at night knowing our efforts count. Rather than generating piles of meaningless paper (and lines of meaningless code), we’re doing all we can to make work more interesting, human beings more productive, and the world a little better.

name: SpaBoom
tag_list: gift, gift-certificate, gift-certificates, e-commerce, service, email, web-hosting, dynamic-website
overview:
SpaBoom is a business-to-business play that specializes in ecommerce functionality for service-based organizations, helping these organizations realize greater revenues and business leads from the Internet. BoomTime’s initial services include robust Instant Gift Certificate functionality, Dynamic Websites, and an Appointment Request feature.

Service-based companies have been traditionally under-served on the Internet, since it’s difficult to “buy a massage” over the Internet. Given that the service-based sector is the largest sector in the US and world economies, and general public acceptance of the Internet for business transactions has steadily increased over the years, SpaBoom is well positioned for growth.

SpaBoom is one of several brands the company uses to reach niche markets. The other brands are CoverBoom and BoomTime, for restaurants and the horizontal market, respectively.

SpaBoom first tested the concept of Instant Gift Certificates with spas and salons, due to the perceived importance of gift certificates (up to 30% of their business) and Internet leads to these organizations. It was discovered that almost one-half of gift certificate purchasers wait to buy until the last 48 hours of a holiday or event. Providing an instant gift capability has allowed SpaBoom customers to greatly increase their sales by catering to the last-minute purchaser, where the delays associated with manual fulfillment and/or postal mail is nonexistent.

In 2006, SpaBoom started work on a distribution model, that enables it to sell the Instant Gift Certificates of its clients and push the inventory of Instant Gift Certificates to other distribution networks. SpaEmergency (www.spaemergency.com) was formed in 2006 to sell Spa and Salon Instant Gift Certificates, and a strategic relationship with Zagat Survey (www.zagat.com) was formed in 2008 for its CoverBoom clients.

By July, 2008, SpaBoom boasts over 10% of the Spa market with 2,600 spas and salons in North America. It is anticipated that CoverBoom will boast over 1,000 restaurants by the end of 2008.

name: Restyleme
overview:
RestyleMe is a style advice website that allows people to rate other people’s styles.

RestyleMe has several unique features:

  • Pinpoint photo marking - In addition to being able to write comments, you can mark on users’ photos with a single click and give them feedback about their style with pinpoint accuracy. Don’t like that jacket? Click on it on the photo and let them know exactly how you feel.

  • Tagging of clothing items - You can tag style items or brands by selecting areas on your profile photo. Not only this allows you to show off your style, (combined with users’ ability of marking on photos) it also allows you to see how much people like that new shirt of yours.

  • Detailed bar graph results - You can view detailed stats about people’s opinion on your style shown with bar graphs. You can even filter your results based on age range, gender, and your home country. So you will know right away whether younger women like your new hair style for example.

  • We also feature social networking components like friend / favorite lists and user-friendly messaging.

The website is completely free and the registration is quick.

name: uCubd
overview: The Ucubd semantic project was first conceived in 2006 by a group of technologists setting out to add a compelling new dimension to the web. The goal was to bring all the disparate parts of the web together under one common and accessible interface. From day one, Ucubd was the only place on the web where you could assemble content in it’s native form and fit it together into a compact visual collage. As we watched the web evolve, it became much more apparent that access to the ever-growing number of web API’s allowed fascinating interoperability and communication between web applications. So, we adapted. Ucubd became not only a way to bring digital content together, but a bridge between the widely available web APIs provided by companies like YouTube and Twitter. We took on the complicated wiring ourselves - giving users simple one step templates that allowed them to build context aware media mashups in seconds. We called these new kinds of mashups “cubes”.

overview:
Sense Networks applies big science to mobile location data for predictive analytics in advertising.

The company’s technology platform, MacroSense®, builds proprietary mobile user profiles which incorporate over 1,000 behavioral attributes that are extracted from location data. MacroSense receives streaming location data from mobile phones in real-time, processes the data in the context of billions of historical data points, and analyzes it to better understand human activity and apply the insights to mobile advertising.

MacroSense currently processes 170 billion location points per month into profiles. More than any company other than Google or Facebook.

Sense’s AdMatch™ real-time bidding ad platform targets and serves the ads through mobile ad exchanges, acting as a Demand Side Platform (DSP) with brand and agency clients. The integration of rich MacroSense profiles provides a built in Data Management Platform (DMP) to deliver extremely sophisticated and effective mobile ad targeting “beyond place.”

Sense Networks was founded in 2003 and incorporated in early 2006. The founding team is composed of top computer scientists from MIT and Columbia University.

Sense Networks won the 2009 AlwaysOn OnMedia Top 100 Award, was named by Gartner as one of its 2009 Cool Vendors in Context-Aware Computing, and was proclaimed one of “The World’s Most Intriguing Startups” by Business Week. CEO David Petersen has been featured by Forbes magazine in their series of Forbes Insights profiles of Thought Leaders changing the business landscape.

overview:
MyPronostic.com is a prediction site on all subjects and a collective intelligence tool at the service of punters and professionals.

Created in August 2007 in Paris, France, the company is based on the experience of jelavaisdit.com the famous political advisors’ predictions video blog during the French presidential election in May 2007.

The idea is to develop a user based website of pronostics on different subjects. MyPronostic.com is online since March 2008.

To go further MyPronostic is :

  • A prediction game and a service platform for punters.
  • An application to organize prediction games.
  • A collective intelligence tool at the service of the general public and corporate deciders.

A prediction game website on which users can sell their expertise to buyers of predictions.

Once in the site, the user/forecaster is invited to submit a prediction, free of charge, on the outcome of an event on subjects as varied as sport, films, politics, stock exchange and all other types of events, in particular those featured on betting sites.

Each user/forecaster thereby benefits from a detailed background of past predictions, ranked by category, enabling the site to identify the best in each area and to highlight them using scoring systems based on specific algorithms. Any forecaster can put their predictions up for sale and “expert forecasters” identified by the site will also be able to determine the price of their predictions.

When a prediction is sold, the revenue is shared by the forecaster and the MyPronostic.com.

They are also currently developing a Business offer to personalized modules enabling the implementation of prediction games for business customers (companies, works’ councils and local authorities) and a polls offer to be able to ask question to expert of MyPronostic on different subject.

overview: InfoSpace created the Dogpile search engine because your time is important to us. Dogpile looks at all of them, decides which are most relevant to your search, eliminates duplicates and reveals them to you. In the end, you get a list of results more complete than anywhere else on the Web. The time-saving philosophy of metasearch is so important to us that it even inspired our name! In rugby, players come together and pile on top of one another. This is exactly what Dogpile’s metasearch technology does – it compiles all the best results in one easy-to-access place! And because every good team needs a loyal mascot, we adopted Arfie. You can find him any time on Dogpile, where he works as a retriever of sorts. When you search the Web on Dogpile, he’s quick to fetch the exact results you want when you want them.

name: Sivoo
overview:
Sivoo provides IT infrastructure for IP video, and has created a digital-media asset management solution to intake, encode, distribute, and monetize video across distribution channels including Internet, mobile, IPTV, and cable using Internet protocol (IP).

This solution is called CEDR, which is an acronym describing the life-cycle of IP-managed video (Capture, Encode, Distribute, and Report). CEDR leverages what we call “cluster-in-cloud computing” in order to radically transform this life-cycle from a cost-intensive, geographically specific, and hardware-dependent process to a cost efficient, decentralized, and software based process that resides in the “cloud.” CEDR has been developed by SIVOO and is proprietary to the Company.

CEDR creates digital video assets from any format or source including Satellite, Internet stream, hard media, or digital file; encodes captured video into any and/or multiple specifications like CableLabs, Flash, Windows Media, Quicktime, H.264, MPEG2, etc.; distributes these assets to any IP video or broadcast distribution outlet; and tracks the views and monetization of assets in a single report.

With CEDR, video assets are easily and automatically managed and distributed by and between MSOs, content aggregators, and distribution outlets. CEDR allows customers to pull video assets between locations as either a file or as a stream-link on the Internet Edge. CEDR can also push video assets to Internet sites like YouTube and MetaCafe, mobile platforms like Verizon V-Cast, IPTV providers like Verizon FIOS TV and Verismo, and cable companies like Comcast.

CEDR distribution outlets include AOL, Brightcove, Charter Communications, eyespot, Grouper, Guba, HotWire, iFilm, iTunes Podcasts, Joost, jumpcut, JumpTV, MediaMelon, MetaCafe, MobiTV, MySpace, SES Americom, Terra, Verismo, Verizon FIOS TV, Verizon V-Cast, Videoegg, Vimeo, VOY, VSocial, and YouTube. SIVOO is actively growing its distribution reach.

SIVOO earns fees from processing video through CEDR and shares in the advertising revenue generated by views across CEDR distribution outlets.

overview:
The company goal of jobirn.com is to become the free real time platform for recruiters and hiring managers.

Jobirn.com was founded on observation of the following two issues in recruiting market.

  1. Ineffective communication channel - usually an e-mail based communication channel is costly to communicate in. There are long delays and lacks interaction. Video interview is something feasible technically, but not commonly available.

  2. Spams - Email based recruiting are subject to spams. Applicants are forced to send hundreds or thousands of copies of their resumes, given that response rate is so low. It’s very hard for recruiters to pick the right one.

Jobirn.com solution is a real time online system. Recruiters stay online most of the time, without logging to jobirn.com. All they need to do is to bundle their messenger with jobirn.

A video Interview comes handy, when they find qualified applicants, willing for a face-to-face conversation.

The strict Spam-Control policy protects recruiters from spam. Because it’s a chat-based system, applicants may not spam - if they are reported 3 times, their account will be closed.

When a band is signed to a record label, the label provides the band with money called an advance which will help the band pay for recording, merch, CDs and more. The band will then have to pay back the advance thru CD, merch sales, etc. before the band will see any profits for themselves.

With Faneebo, bands can set up and run their own Fan Club which will act as their own personal record label run by the band and in turn will allow fans to gain access to premium content while at the same time providing bands with the needed funds to help record, tour, buy merch, and more in which the bands won’t have to worry about paying back.

overview:
Passitto is an online platform for business networking, with an emphasis on sending and receiving business referrals.

Passitto makes it easy to offer referrals to your friends, group members or the entire Passitto community. Referrals can be offered for free, or you can also require members to bid credits to express their interest in your referral. You simply enter the general details of a referral, members can then review these details and can express their interest. After the close of an offering period for the referral, the user is presented with a list of members who are interested in the referral.

Once the user selects a winner using their own criteria, the credits that the winner used to express an interest in the referral are awarded to the user. This is a true pay or play model, as Passitto credits can be obtained by exchanging referrals or by purchasing credits.

Passitto incorporates traditional business social networking features found on other websites, such user profiles, connections, and groups; however, with Passitto, these features aim to do more than merely connect users to each other. These features aim to create a community of users who actively generate and reward each other for sending and receiving business referrals.

The Passitto community is comprised of professionals representing all types of industries. Passitto can expand users networking circles far beyond their traditional offline leads groups, while also providing the tools and resources to compliment and create virtual extensions of their offline groups.

overview:

This segment markets its products through specialty toy retailers, mass merchandisers, mail-order companies, and variety stores, as well as independent distributors worldwide. name: iPling
overview:
At iPling, we develop and market fun & easy-to-use mobile apps that harness the power and ubiquity of SMS messaging.

We are building both, high-end apps for smartphones as well as services that can be accessed by the mass market through virtually any mobile phone without the need of data connections and downloads. Our marketing folks are currently spending most of their time south of the border (in Mexico), with plans to launch a grass-roots marketing campaign in the US in the spring of 2013.

iPling’s underlying mission is to provide real-time communication services that encourage people to speak up and to reach out (way beyond friends & family). As our founder often says - “You’ll be surprised by all the amazing people nearby who can enrich your life”.

Our services have been approved by, and are currently “live” with, 14 cellular carriers in the U.S. and Mexico, including AT&T, Verizon Wireless, Sprint/Nextel, T-Mobile, Telcel & Movistar (Telefonica).

iPling was founded in January 2007 and operates out of offices in San Francisco, Mexico City and Chennai (India). For additional information send an email to info@ipling.com or call 1(866) 637-9995 within the United States.

name: Zhenai
overview:
Dr. Song Li is an investment banker-turned serial Internet entrepreneur. Song is the founder and chairman of Zhenai.com, the largest online matchmaking site in China with 28 million registered members as of May 2011.

Prior to founding Zhenai.com, Song was chairman and co-founder of MemeStar, once China’s largest mobile SMS-based dating service provider with 2.2 million paying members, which was acquired by the NASDAQ-listed Sina Corporation in January 2003.

Before becoming an Internet entrepreneur, Song was a professional investment banker, working as a Vice President of debt derivative products at Bear Stearns’ New York office and as an Executive Director of equity derivative products at Morgan Stanley’s Hong Kong office.

Song has a Ph.D. in finance from Columbia University in the United States.

name: Plutolife
overview:
A global leader in mobile community development and publishing of mobile content, Plutolife’s products generate high levels of recurring revenue through continuous and persistent end-user experience. Mobile social networking and user-generated content are Plutolife’s expertise.

History Established in 1999 Plutolife’s focus is mobile community platforms, community applications and mobile dating and chat applications.

Plutolife is the result of a June 2004 merger between Plutonium Software (established 1999) and Live the Game (established 2000) in Norway. Both companies were known as true pioneers in developing mass-market mobile entertainment. Live the Game’s success was in SMS-based games and dating services. This fused with Plutonium’s unique expertise in JAVA-games, set the stage for a powerhouse within the mobile entertainment industry.

Plutolife has over 8 years experience of managing communities in excess of 500,000 users ensuring users’ experience is fun, simple, exciting and safe.

Plutolife today is the developer of the world’s largest mobile dating platform that it publishes itself in Scandinavia and white labels for partners outside of Scandinavia.

The platform is currently connected and distributed successfully in 17 countries where active communities are managed and moderated to ensure the most pleasurable experience for all users.

Plutolife act as technology supplier to some of the world’s largest online dating brands and our technology today support the largest mobile dating platform in North America.

Today Plutolife continues to expand it global distribution and presence to all 4 corners of the globe, spanning 5 continents. Plutolife has firmly established itself as a leader in mobile community entertainment with numerous hit applications distributed through 70+ partnerships to date.

Expertise Plutolife is a pro in creating and delivering dating, flirting and mobile community entertainment that generates reoccurring revenue. Plutolife has a well-rounded approach to development and delivery that combines the best of technological know-how, end-user savvy and a sharp focus on the revenue line.

Plutolife is also home to some of the world’s top connected application Java gurus, having developed dozens of hit community mobile games and applications. Mobilove Java is one of Plutolife’s latest forays into Java and aims to set a new standard on what is capable with Java on a mobile phone. With Mobilove Java, Plutolife has finally perfected the optimal mobile dating experience.

Above development and delivery of its own products, Plutolife has emerged as a master in mobile content distribution and delivery for third party vendors.

Lavalife’s uniqueness is based on:

A selection of web, voice and mobile-based products and services providing “anytime, anywhere, anyhow” access to like-minded individuals.

Three distinct communities on lavalifeVOICE and lavalife.com where open-minded singles can choose to participate Dating, Relationship and Intimate Encounters

name: Vumber
overview:
It’s your anyphone, anytime, anywhere phone number that keeps your identity private—until you decide it not to be.

A Vumber is a number from any area code you want, linked to your home, cell, or work phone. When someone calls your Vumber, Vumber lets you control how you handle the call: you can a) answer it; b) send them to VumberMail; c) give them a busy signal; d) tell them the number is out of service; or e) play them a custom message you create.

It provides unequaled privacy protection when anyone calls your Vumber, and when you call anyone. And it’s not limited to a pre-defined one-to-one calling relationship like you sometimes see out there—it is as simple as having another phone number. Even simpler. Vumber puts you in total control of your communications and your identity.

You can call from your Vumber, too. Just dial your Vumber, and then dial the number. It’s that easy. It is simple and instant to use. With Vumber, you get a flexible, privacy-protected, portable, disposable telephone number and a private voice mail box (VumberMail). And don’t worry… You still have your existing numbers, and you can still call and get calls from them. But now you also have a number with total control. Now you have your Vumber.

name: Parship
overview:
PARSHIP.co.uk is the UK’s first compatibility-based online dating service, specifically for people who are serious about forming a lasting relationship. It is the British subsidiary of Europe’s largest and most successful serious online dating service with millions of members, who are predominantly affluent, educated men and women between 28 and 55 years old. Since its launch in Germany in 2001, PARSHIP has matched thousands of single people who are serious about forming a long-lasting relationship.

The first step is an 80-question psychometric test, which is free of charge and takes about 20 minutes to complete. The results of the test create a fascinating profile of each member’s personality. Using methods based on years of scientific research, this profile is then carefully matched with the profiles of other members whose balance of similar and complementary characteristics marks them out as a potential partner for the new member.

PARSHIP.co.uk operates a 3-tiered pricing system: £35 for 1 month, £57 for 3 months, £84 for 6 months. 75% of people who register with the PARSHIP site go on to complete the psychometric compatibility test. In fact, 2,500 people across Europe complete the test every day.

PARSHIP GmbH, headquartered in Hamburg, is 87%-owned by Holtzbrinck networXs AG, part of the Georg von Holtzbrinck publishing group, one of Germany’s largest publishing companies with financial interests in more than 80 companies including the Macmillan Group. Driven primarily by revenue-share partnerships with leading names in print and online media, including Express Newspapers, Hellomagazine.com, FAZ, Die Zeit and Der Spiegel, as well as Tiscali and T-online, PARSHIP GmbH has expanded to cover UK, Austria, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain and France.

overview:
Intacct is a provider of web-based or cloud financial management and accounting applications for businesses and CPA firms. Intacct is based in San Jose, California.

BACKGROUND

Intacct was founded in 1999 to provide small and midsized businesses an cloud-based alternative to on-premise and desktop accounting solutions like QuickBooks, Microsoft Dynamics, and Sage. The company’s financial management and accounting applications, in use by more than 6,000 organizations from startups to public companies, are designed to improve business performance and make finance more productive. The Intacct system includes accounting, contract management, revenue management, project and fund accounting, inventory management, purchasing, vendor management, financial consolidation, and financial reporting applications, all delivered over the Internet via cloud computing.

The Intacct name was derived from “internet” and “accounting.” Intacct helped pioneer Software-as-a-Service or “cloud” computing, and its products were some of the first to use a multi-tenant architecture, which defines a unique approach to software design that significantly lowers the cost of delivering and using the applications.

Intacct is headquartered in San Jose, California. For more information, please visit www.intacct.com or call 877-437-7765.

name: TradingUp Online
overview:
Tradinguponline.com is an online social community that allows its users to trade up (swap) things “things that they have no use for anymore” with other users to get what they probably would like to have.

Let say you want something badly - for example a Sony PS3 console; but all you have is a fancy pen, perhaps given to you by an Uncle three years ago. Of course no one is going to trade PS3 for your pen. But what if someone has a PS3 and would like to exchange it for an X-Box. Some guy who’s got an X-Box to trade wants to replace the carburetor in his car, and a lady whose father owns a mechanic shop wouldn’t mind asking daddy to spare one of those carburetors laying around the garage for her antique pen collection. So that leaves a trail for you to connect the dots. Start with something little - something you have, connect and trade it up until you find and get something you want. There is no selling of products between users, trades between users are practically Free!

name: TeamStreamz
overview:
WHAT WE DO:

We are a nex-gen “intelligent push” platform for subscriber-based websites. Our technology is a desktop application and browser plugin (2MB) that enables users to download and cache hi-def media in computer idle time, then play back inside existing websites via PHP tags. In so doing we allow webmasters to easily “SuperSize” their pages for subscribers who have our plugin.

WHAT PROBLEMS DO WE SOLVE?

  1. We overcome the on-demand barrier for high definition content delivery to social network and fan-based websites.
  2. Add HD page content to existing websites via one-line code tags without expensive rebuilding of site framework.
  3. Conserve bandwidth costs by “pushing” in-demand video downloads to users in off-peak times, avoiding streaming video headaches.
  4. Save on repeat downloads of webpage graphics by allowing users to keep their favorite large video files and web page contents on their desktops long term, avoiding the need to keep re-downloading repeatedly. This is especially true for Social Network websites that have a high volume of repeat daily user downloads.
  5. Have subscribers experience instantaneous web page load times of Hi-Def content for the first time ever!
  6. Publishers can charge extra fees to subscribers for high definition files that they can keep.
  7. Enable websites to exploit new ad revenues with a new HD pipeline to users by delivering powerful desktop apps, etc. in a secure channel they own.

WHY IS IT REVOLUTIONARY?

  1. We are the first company ever to provide a non-streaming solution to high definition content delivery that runs invisibly alongside low-def content inside the same website, guaranteeing smooth, high quality playback of large rich media assets for fan bases.
  2. The SuperSizeWeb browser enhancement enables web publishers to create Hi-Def duplicates of their websites - without rebuilding the site. Publishers can maintain a low-rez and a hi-rez version of the same site easily.
  3. Our desktop application contains the combined features of Web Servers, Download Managers and Browser rich media plugins in a tiny 2MB package.
  4. Website subscribers can experience ZERO load times for impressive full screen hi-def web experiences.

THE BUSINESS MODEL:

Many websites are struggling to make the transition to a High Definition web. For a fraction of a website rebuild (or high-end video streaming tech implementation), Social Network and repeat-user websites can deliver hi-def experiences to their daily visitors and subscribers. We license our platform to companies for $250 per month, plus a $499 setup fee. A topical selling point is that we can save web publishers streaming, hosting, bandwidth, and website upgrade costs - which they can then re-invest in high definition aspects of their website’s future growth.

Its products include Barracuda Spam Firewall, an integrated hardware and software solution for the protection of email servers from spam, virus, spoofing, phishing, and spyware attacks; Barracuda Web Filter, a solution to enforce organizational Internet usage policies; Barracuda IM Firewall, an IM solution that provides IM server and gateway technologies; and Barracuda Web Site Firewall, which offers protection against hackers’ attempts. The company’s products also include Barracuda Message Archiver, an email archiving solution; and Barracuda Load Balancer that integrates server load balancing and network intrusion prevention solutions into network appliances. In addition, it provides IM protection, application server load balancing, and message archiving appliances; and Barracuda Backup Service, a local and cloud-based data backup and disaster recovery solution hosted by data centers for businesses in Europe. The company’s solutions deliver protection against enterprise-class spam, spyware, viruses, and IT infrastructure threats. It sells its products through a network of distributors in the United States and internationally.

The company was founded in 2002 and is headquartered in Campbell, California with additional offices in the United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, India, Pakistan, the United Arab Emirates, and China.

name: GeoMe
overview:
Geome will enable anybody to leave a digital post-it note from their mobile phone in a specific location addressing another individual or a community of them.

GeoMe will create a segmented community with access to relevant content that will unleash the full potential of location-based search and personalised advertising

Mobile users can leave a message, known as a LMS (Location Messaging Service), at any geographical point. When the recipient reaches the defined point, the message appears on his or her mobile phone display. Unlike the classic SMS, the message is not sent to the addressee as such, but is only activated when the addressee comes within a defined radius of the location specified for the LMS.

Another difference is that, if required, the message can be read not only by one person but also by a specific group or people or by anyone with a mobile phone—like a real graffiti plastered on a building wall. This allows a whole range of new applications, for example to make arrangements with a friend, to leave recommendation for a food dish in a restaurant, to leave a love message, to start a treasury hunt and for advertising messages aimed at a large readership.

Implementing this with SMS alone would get very expensive for the consumer and probably a bit annoying as well if the user was constantly bombarded by messages. Therefore our solution is a combination of push and pull. Private messages are pushed to the user and group messages and messages intended for all (e.g. a restaurant review) are pulled by the user from an easy-to-use Java application or a WAP-site. The Java application also makes posting messages extremely easy with a similar step-by-step experience to sending a SMS.

The service will work on all mobile phones in a basic version with SMS and WAP and on all Java MIDP 2.0 phones with the applications based version. There are public areas that anyone can tag as well as private ones that can be restricted to selected friends. Each text tag can also have an image attached to it.

name: Frequent Flyer Network
overview:
The Frequent Flyer Network comprises many of the most popular and highly regarded travel sites in the niche of business travelers: InsideFlyer, WebFlyer, FlyerTalk, MileageManager, BoardingArea, SeatExpert, MileDonor.

The Frequent Flyer Network’s foray into the online world began in 1987 by publishing frequent flyer info on Compuserve and NewsNet. In 1995, the group hit the Web with the launch of WebFlyer.com. In addition to being the first online information portal for frequent flyers, WebFlyer hosted what was arguably the first business travel blog, Gary Leff’s “View From The Wing” in 2002. The Frequent Flyer Network became an official network in 1996 when InsideFlyer Online was launched with AOL. FlyerTalk.com followed in 1998, and nearly 12 million posts later it has grown to become the Internet’s most popular online community for frequent travelers. Launched business travel blog portal, BoardingArea.com in February, 2008 and followed with an interest acquisition of SeatExpert in late 2008. As well, they originated the concept of frequent flyer account aggregation with the intro of MileageManager in the early 1990s as a manual service later porting it over the the Web. The Network also developed services to help members redeem their rewards with the highly popular AwardPlanner program which won several annual awards from Conde Naste Traveler magazine. This service is now being repurposed to an automated service incorporated within the MileageManager service.

Other claims to fame? Introduced the first and only protection program for frequent flyer miles – AwardGuard – in the early 1990s, and provided that service for many years providing safety and security of miles when airlines went bankrupt. Ended that program following 9/11 when the prospect of continuing to find insurers willing to underwrite the policy dried up with the outlook of many airlines seemingly fragile.

overview:
Wigadoo is a co-ordinated purchasing platform for leisure and travel services.

Wigadoo targets the pain of organising a group of friends when money is involved. Whether you need to book a ski chalet or a bunch of theatre tickets, Wigadoo makes it easy to get money from friends upfront, before the event needs to be paid for.

The way it works is as follows. A user goes to the site with an idea in mind. Say, for instance, the user wants to book a holiday to Cancun with a group of friends. They want at least 5 friends to come along needs $500 from each of them. The user create an invite on Wigadoo that they e-mail out to their friends. If their friends are interested, they’re asked to give credit or debit card details and to pledge the $500. But no money is taken from their cards - and no money can be taken - unless 5 people sign up. If the user gets 5 people to back the plan, they can then collect the money (anything up to $500 from each of their friends). That money is then pooled into an online event account that comes with a prepaid virtual MasterCard that they can use to book and pay for whatever it is the group needs. If the user doesn’t want to use the Online Event Account, they can just transfer the money to their own bank account and pay in cash or with their own card.

overview:
ListensToYou is a new online advertising model that empowers consumers; shifting from the old model of just tracking users’ online behavior.

Other websites watch you. This one listens to you. listenstoyou.com offers a free service where you voice marketing and product preferences - ads you do and do not want displayed on websites you visit. Without revealing ANY personal information they help websites serve you ads based on these expressed preferences.

As it grows, ListensToYou will 1). protect families from unwanted or offensive ads, 2) give consumers a forum to improve online ad targeting, 3) present users with relevant, timely ad content and 4) tell marketers to find and present products rather than forcing consumers to waste time searching for them.

ListensToYou plans to integrate with current ad serving technologies rather than compete with them.
